function hex2rgb(h){h=h.replace('#','');if(h.length===3)h=h.split('').map(c=>c+c).join('');const n=parseInt(h,16);return[(n>>16)&255,(n>>8)&255,n&255];}
function rgb2hex(r,g,b){return'#'+[r,g,b].map(v=>Math.round(clamp(v,0,255)).toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');}

function rgba(h,a){const c=hex2rgb(h);return`rgba(${c[0]},${c[1]},${c[2]},${a})`;}
function toHsl(h){let[r,g,b]=hex2rgb(h).map(v=>v/255);const mx=Math.max(r,g,b),mn=Math.min(r,g,b);let H=0,S=0;const L=(mx+mn)/2;if(mx!==mn){const d=mx-mn;S=L>.5?d/(2-mx-mn):d/(mx+mn);H=mx===r?(g-b)/d+(g<b?6:0):mx===g?(b-r)/d+2:(r-g)/d+4;H/=6;}return[H,S,L];}

function collectColors(raw){
  const map={},add=h=>{map[h]=(map[h]||0)+1;};
  (raw.match(/#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}\b|#[0-9a-fA-F]{3}\b/g)||[]).forEach(x=>{let h=x.slice(1).toLowerCase();if(h.length===3)h=h.split('').map(c=>c+c).join('');add('#'+h);});
  (raw.match(/rgba?\(\s*\d{1,3}\s*[, ]\s*\d{1,3}\s*[, ]\s*\d{1,3}\s*(?:[,\/]\s*[\d.]+\s*)?\)/g)||[]).forEach(x=>{const m=x.match(/\d+(?:\.\d+)?/g).map(Number);if(m.length>=4&&m[3]===0)return;add(rgb2hex(m[0],m[1],m[2]));});
  return Object.entries(map).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).map(e=>e[0]);
}
function pickPalette(list){
  const sat=h=>toHsl(h)[1];
  const primary=list.find(h=>lum(h)<0.5&&sat(h)>0.25)||list.find(h=>lum(h)<0.5&&lum(h)>0.002)||'#0b1b4d';
  const sec=list.find(h=>lum(h)>0.85)||'#ffffff';
  let accent=list.find(h=>{const s=toHsl(h);return s[1]>0.5&&s[2]>0.35&&s[2]<0.75&&dist(h,primary)>90;});
  if(!accent){accent=fromHsl(toHsl(primary)[0],0.9,0.58);}
  return{primary,secondary:sec,accent};
}
function extract(raw){
  const res={name:'',tagline:'',desc:'',headings:[],items:[],cta:'',colors:collectColors(raw)};

    return res;
  }
  const doc=new DOMParser().parseFromString(raw,'text/html');
  const txt=e=>((e&&e.textContent)||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
  const meta=n=>{const e=doc.querySelector('meta[name="'+n+'"],meta[property="'+n+'"]');return e?(e.getAttribute('content')||'').trim():'';};
  if(doc.querySelector('.meta-item')&&/preview visual/i.test(doc.title||'')){

    const site=ps.find(p=>/^\s*site:/i.test(p.textContent));
    if(site){const s=txt(site).replace(/^site:\s*/i,'').split('|').map(x=>x.trim());res.name=s[0]||'';res.tagline=s.slice(1).join(' — ');}
    res.desc=txt(ps.find(p=>!/^\s*site:/i.test(p.textContent)&&txt(p).length>20));
    const box=[...doc.querySelectorAll('.meta-item')].find(m=>/t[ií]tulos/i.test(txt(m.querySelector('h2'))));
    if(box&&box.querySelector('p')){
      const lines=box.querySelector('p').innerHTML.split(/<br\s*\/?>/i).map(s=>s.replace(/<[^>]+>/g,'').replace(/&/g,'&').trim()).filter(Boolean);
      const idx=lines.findIndex(l=>/(…|\.\.\.|:)$/.test(l));
      if(idx>=0){res.headings=lines.slice(0,idx+1);res.items=lines.slice(idx+1);}else res.headings=lines;
    }
    return res;
  }
  doc.querySelectorAll('script,style,noscript,template').forEach(n=>n.remove());
  const title=(doc.title||meta('og:title')||'').trim();
  const parts=title.split(/\s+[|\-–—]\s+|\s*\|\s*/).filter(Boolean);
  res.name=meta('og:site_name')||parts[0]||'';
  res.tagline=parts.slice(1).join(' — ');
  res.desc=meta('description')||meta('og:description')||txt([...doc.querySelectorAll('p')].find(p=>txt(p).length>60));
  const seen=new Set();
  [...doc.querySelectorAll('h1,h2,h3')].forEach(h=>{const t=txt(h);if(t.length>=3&&t.length<=100&&!seen.has(t.toLowerCase())){seen.add(t.toLowerCase());res.headings.push(t);}});

  [...doc.querySelectorAll('li,h4')].forEach(e=>{if(e.closest('nav,footer,header'))return;const t=txt(e);if(t.length>=3&&t.length<=60&&!seen.has(t.toLowerCase())){seen.add(t.toLowerCase());res.items.push(t);}});

  if(!res.tagline&&res.desc)res.tagline=clip(res.desc.split(/(?<=[.!?])\s/)[0],90);
  return res;
}
function applyExtraction(x){
  if(x.name)state.brand.name=clip(x.name,60);

    return (t+(t&&!/[.:…!?]$/.test(t)?':':'')+' '+items+'.').trim();
  }

    let msg=t;if(sub)msg+='. '+sub;if(s.url)msg+='. Acesse '+s.url;return msg.replace(/\.{2,}/g,'.').trim()+'.';
  }
  let msg=t;if(sub)msg+='. '+sub;return msg.replace(/\.{2,}/g,'.').trim()+'.';
}

/* ---------- durações ---------- */
function autoDur(s){
  const w=t=>plain(t).split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;let d;
  if(s.kind==='intro')d=3.2;
  else if(s.kind==='title')d=2.4+0.28*w((s.title||'')+' '+(s.sub||''));
  else if(s.kind==='bullets')d=2.2+0.4*(s.items||[]).length+0.15*w((s.title||'')+' '+(s.items||[]).join(' '));
  else d=3.8;
  if(abuf[s.id])d=Math.max(d,abuf[s.id].duration+0.9);
  return clamp(d,2.2,9);
}
function fitDurations(){
  state.scenes.forEach(s=>{s.dur=+autoDur(s).toFixed(1);});

  if(T){for(let it=0;it<5;it++){const k=T/totalDur();state.scenes.forEach(s=>{s.dur=+clamp(s.dur*k,2,14).toFixed(1);});}}
}

const hash=k=>{const x=Math.sin(k*127.1+311.7)*43758.5453;return x-Math.floor(x);};

function drawLayer(i,lt,inP,outP,W,H,S,th){
  const sc=state.scenes[i],cx=W/2,cy=H/2;let alpha=1,wipe=null;
  ctx.save();
  if(outP>0){
    const k=transOf(i),e=easeIO(outP);
    if(k==='fade')alpha*=1-e;
    else if(k==='slide'){ctx.translate(-W*0.3*e,0);alpha*=1-e;}
    else if(k==='zoom'){ctx.translate(cx,cy);ctx.scale(1+0.18*e,1+0.18*e);ctx.translate(-cx,-cy);alpha*=1-e;}
    else if(k==='up'){ctx.translate(0,-H*0.15*e);alpha*=1-e;}
    else if(k==='wipe'){alpha*=1-0.35*e;}
  }
  if(inP<1&&i>0){
    const k=transOf(i-1),e=easeIO(inP);
    if(k==='fade')alpha*=e;
    else if(k==='slide'){ctx.translate(W*0.3*(1-e),0);alpha*=e;}
    else if(k==='zoom'){ctx.translate(cx,cy);const z=0.86+0.14*e;ctx.scale(z,z);ctx.translate(-cx,-cy);alpha*=e;}
    else if(k==='up'){ctx.translate(0,H*0.15*(1-e));alpha*=e;}
    else if(k==='wipe'){
      const xb=-W*0.25+e*W*1.5,sk=H*0.12;
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-20,-20);ctx.lineTo(xb+sk,-20);ctx.lineTo(xb-sk,H+20);ctx.lineTo(-20,H+20);ctx.closePath();ctx.clip();wipe={xb,sk,e};
    }
  }
  const kb=1+0.035*clamp(lt/((+sc.dur||3)+TR()));
  ctx.translate(cx,cy);ctx.scale(kb,kb);ctx.translate(-cx,-cy);
  ctx.globalAlpha=clamp(alpha);
  drawScene(sc,lt,W,H,S,th);
  ctx.restore();
  if(wipe&&wipe.e>0&&wipe.e<1){
    const bw=46*S;ctx.save();ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(wipe.xb+wipe.sk,-20);ctx.lineTo(wipe.xb+wipe.sk+bw,-20);ctx.lineTo(wipe.xb-wipe.sk+bw,H+20);ctx.lineTo(wipe.xb-wipe.sk,H+20);ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle=rgba(th.accent,0.95);ctx.shadowColor=rgba(th.accent,0.8);ctx.shadowBlur=30*S;ctx.fill();ctx.restore();
  }
}

function draw(t){
  const W=cv.width,H=cv.height,S=Math.min(W,H)/1080;
  ctx.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0);ctx.globalAlpha=1;ctx.shadowBlur=0;ctx.setLineDash([]);
  const th=theme();paintBG(t,W,H,S,th);
  const n=state.scenes.length,total=totalDur(),tr=TR(),S0=starts();
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const sc=state.scenes[i],dur=+sc.dur||3,st=S0[i],en=st+dur,vs=i>0?st-tr:st;
    if(t<vs||(t>=en&&i<n-1))continue;
    const lt=t-vs,outP=i<n-1?clamp((t-(en-tr))/tr):0,inP=i>0?clamp(lt/tr):1;
    drawLayer(i,lt,inP,outP,W,H,S,th);
  }
  const ef=clamp((t-(total-0.4))/0.4);
  if(ef>0){ctx.fillStyle=rgba(th.bg1,ef);ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);}
  ctx.fillStyle=th.accent;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W*clamp(t/total),Math.max(6,8*S));

let cancelFlag=false,lastBlob=null,lastName='',pipeBusy=false;
function pickMime(pref){

function baseName(){

async function generate(){
  if(!window.MediaRecorder||!cv.captureStream){setMsg('#msgGen','Este navegador não suporta gravação de vídeo. Use Chrome, Edge, Safari 14.1+ ou Firefox atualizados.',true);return false;}
  if(!state.scenes.length){setMsg('#msgGen','Adicione ao menos uma cena.',true);return false;}
  pause();setBusy(true);cancelFlag=false;$('#result').style.display='none';
  setMsg('#msgGen','Preparando fonts e frames…');await loadFonts();
  const total=totalDur(),stream=cv.captureStream(30);
  const mime=pickMime(state.fmt),opts={videoBitsPerSecond:state.quality==='720'?4e6:8e6};if(mime)opts.mimeType=mime;
  let rec;try{rec=new MediaRecorder(stream,opts);}catch(e){rec=new MediaRecorder(stream);}
  const chunks=[];rec.ondataavailable=e=>{if(e.data&&e.data.size)chunks.push(e.data);};
  const stopped=new Promise(r=>rec.onstop=r);
  rec.start(250);
  const t0=performance.now();
  await new Promise(resolve=>{
    const step=()=>{
      if(cancelFlag){resolve();return;}
      const t=(performance.now()-t0)/1000;
      draw(Math.min(t,total-0.001));
      $('#bar>i').style.width=(clamp(t/total)*100)+'%';
      setMsg('#msgGen','Gravando… '+fmtT(Math.min(t,total))+' / '+fmtT(total)+' — não feche nem troque de aba.');
      if(t<total+0.3)requestAnimationFrame(step);else resolve();
    };step();
  });
  rec.stop();await stopped;stream.getTracks().forEach(t=>t.stop());
  setBusy(false);tPlay=0;redraw();
  if(cancelFlag){setMsg('#msgGen','Geração cancelada.');return false;}
  const type=(rec.mimeType||mime||'video/webm').split(';')[0],ext=type.includes('mp4')?'mp4':'webm';
  lastBlob=new Blob(chunks,{type});lastName=baseName()+'.'+ext;dirty=false;
  const v=$('#resVideo');try{v.src=URL.createObjectURL(lastBlob);}catch(e){}
  $('#result').style.display='block';
  const fb=state.fmt==='mp4'&&ext!=='mp4'?' · seu navegador grava apenas WebM':'';
  $('#resInfo').textContent=lastName+' · '+(lastBlob.size/1048576).toFixed(1)+' MB'+fb;
  setMsg('#msgGen','Vídeo pronto! Confira abaixo.');
  return true;
}

  state.palette.forEach(h=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='chip';b.style.background=h;b.title=h;b.addEventListener('click',()=>{const t=document.querySelector('input[name=tgt]:checked').value;$('#'+t).value=h;$('#'+t).dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));});box.appendChild(b);});
}
function renderLogo(){const t=$('#logoThumb');if(state.logo){t.src=state.logo;t.style.display='block';$('#btnLogoClear').classList.remove('hide');}else{t.style.display='none';$('#btnLogoClear').classList.add('hide');}}
function setLogo(src){
  state.logo=src;renderLogo();
  if(!src){logoImg=null;refresh();return;}
  const im=new Image();im.onload=()=>{logoImg=im;refresh();};im.onerror=()=>{logoImg=null;};im.src=src;
}
function renderScenes(){
  const box=$('#scenes');box.innerHTML='';
  state.scenes.forEach((s,i)=>{
    const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='scene';d.dataset.i=i;const k=s.kind,b=abuf[s.id];
    d.innerHTML='<div class="srow"><b>'+(i+1)+'</b><select data-f="kind">'+Object.keys(KIND).map(x=>'<option value="'+x+'"'+(x===k?' selected':'')+'>'+KIND[x]+'</option>').join('')+'</select>'
    +'<input type="number" data-f="dur" min="2" max="14" step="0.5" value="'+esc(s.dur)+'" /><span class="note">s</span>'
    +'<select data-f="trans">'+Object.keys(TRANS).map(x=>'<option value="'+x+'"'+(x===(s.trans||'auto')?' selected':'')+'>'+(x==='auto'?'Trans:Auto':TRANS[x])+'</option>').join('')+'</select>'
    +'<span class="sp"></span><button data-a="up">↑</button><button data-a="down">↓</button><button data-a="del">✕</button></div>'
    +'<input type="text" data-f="title" placeholder="Título (use *palavra*)" value="'+esc(s.title)+'">'
    +(k!=='bullets'?'<input type="text" data-f="sub" placeholder="Subtítulo" value="'+esc(s.sub)+'">':'')
    +(k==='bullets'?'<textarea data-f="items" rows="3">'+esc((s.items||[]).join('\n'))+'</textarea>':'')
    +(k==='cta'?'<input type="text" data-f="url" placeholder="URL" value="'+esc(s.url||'')+'">':'')
    +'<div class="narr"><textarea data-f="narr" rows="2" placeholder="Narração">'+esc(s.narr||'')+'</textarea>'
    +'<div class="srow"><button data-a="rec">🎙 Gravar</button><button data-a="aud">📎 Áudio</button>'+(b?'<button data-a="rmaud">✕</button><span class="aud">✔</span>':'')+'</div></div>';
    box.appendChild(d);
  });
}
function refresh(){dirty=true;if(tPlay>totalDur())tPlay=0;redraw();save();}
function afterBrand(){if(!state.edited){state.scenes=buildScenes(state.type);}renderScenes();refresh();}
function applyFormat(){setFormat();refresh();}

function bind(id,fn){$('#'+id).addEventListener('input',e=>fn(e.target.value));}

bind('name',v=>{state.brand.name=v;afterBrand();});
bind('tagline',v=>{state.brand.tagline=v;afterBrand();});
bind('desc',v=>{state.brand.desc=v;afterBrand();});
bind('cta',v=>{state.brand.cta=v;afterBrand();});
bind('cP',v=>{state.colors.primary=v;refresh();});
bind('cS',v=>{state.colors.secondary=v;refresh();});
bind('cA',v=>{state.colors.accent=v;refresh();});
bind('fname',v=>{state.fname=v;save();});
$('#font').addEventListener('change',async e=>{state.font=e.target.value;await loadFonts();refresh();});
$('#type').addEventListener('change',e=>{state.type=e.target.value;if(!state.edited){state.scenes=buildScenes(state.type);renderScenes();}refresh();});
$('#format').addEventListener('change',e=>{state.format=e.target.value;applyFormat();});
$('#quality').addEventListener('change',e=>{state.quality=e.target.value;applyFormat();});
$('#style').addEventListener('change',e=>{state.style=e.target.value;refresh();});
$('#tone').addEventListener('change',e=>{state.tone=e.target.value;save();});
$('#trans').addEventListener('change',e=>{state.trans=e.target.value;refresh();});
$('#tempo').addEventListener('change',e=>{state.tempo=e.target.value;refresh();});

$('#mood').addEventListener('change',e=>{state.mood=e.target.value;save();});

$('#btnExtract').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  const raw=$('#src').value.trim();
  if(!raw){setMsg('#msgExtract','Cole o código-fonte do site.',true);return;}
  try{const x=extract(raw);applyExtraction(x);lastExtracted=raw;syncFields();afterBrand();
    setMsg('#msgExtract','Identidade extraída: '+x.headings.length+' títulos, '+x.items.length+' itens, '+state.palette.length+' cores.');}
  catch(e){setMsg('#msgExtract','Não consegui ler esse conteúdo.',true);}
});
$('#fileHtml').addEventListener('change',e=>{const f=e.target.files[0];if(!f)return;const r=new FileReader();r.onload=()=>{$('#src').value=String(r.result||'');$('#btnExtract').click();};r.readAsText(f);e.target.value='';});
$('#fileLogo').addEventListener('change',e=>{const f=e.target.files[0];if(!f)return;const r=new FileReader();r.onload=()=>setLogo(String(r.result));r.readAsDataURL(f);e.target.value='';});

$('#btnAdd').addEventListener('click',()=>{const s={id:uid(),kind:'title',title:'Nova *cena*',sub:'',items:[],url:'',dur:3.4,trans:'auto',narr:'',narrEdited:false};s.narr=narrFor(s);state.scenes.push(s);state.edited=true;renderScenes();refresh();});
$('#btnFit').addEventListener('click',()=>{fitDurations();renderScenes();refresh();setMsg('#msgScenes','Durações ajustadas.');});
$('#btnAI').addEventListener('click',aiScript);

$('#btnTxt').addEventListener('click',async()=>{
  const txt=state.scenes.map((s,i)=>'Cena '+(i+1)+'\n'+plain(s.narr||narrFor(s))+'\n').join('\n');
  try{const d=await window.claude.use('downloads');if(!d)throw 0;await d.save({filename:baseName()+'-narracao.txt',data:txt});}catch(e){}
});

$('#scenes').addEventListener('input',e=>{
  const el=e.target,card=el.closest('.scene');if(!card)return;const i=+card.dataset.i,f=el.dataset.f,s=state.scenes[i];if(!s||!f||f==='kind'||f==='trans')return;
  if(f==='items')s.items=el.value.split('\n').map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,5);
  else if(f==='dur')s.dur=clamp(parseFloat(el.value)||3,2,14);
  else s[f]=el.value;
  if(f==='narr')s.narrEdited=true;
  state.edited=true;refresh();
});
$('#scenes').addEventListener('change',e=>{
  const el=e.target,card=el.closest('.scene');if(!card)return;const s=state.scenes[+card.dataset.i];
  if(el.dataset.f==='kind'){s.kind=el.value;if(s.kind==='cta'&&!s.url)s.url=domain();state.edited=true;renderScenes();refresh();}
  else if(el.dataset.f==='trans'){s.trans=el.value;state.edited=true;refresh();}
});
$('#scenes').addEventListener('click',e=>{
  const b=e.target.closest('button[data-a]');if(!b)return;const i=+b.closest('.scene').dataset.i,a=b.dataset.a,s=state.scenes[i];
  if(a==='rec'){setMsg('#msgScenes','Recurso em desenvolvimento.');}
  if(a==='aud'){const fi=$('#fileAudio');fi.dataset.i=i;fi.click();}
  if(a==='rmaud'){delete abuf[s.id];renderScenes();refresh();}
  if(a==='del'){delete abuf[s.id];state.scenes.splice(i,1);}
  else if(a==='up'&&i>0)[state.scenes[i-1],state.scenes[i]]=[state.scenes[i],state.scenes[i-1]];
  else if(a==='down'&&i<state.scenes.length-1)[state.scenes[i+1],state.scenes[i]]=[state.scenes[i],state.scenes[i+1]];
  state.edited=true;renderScenes();refresh();
});
document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend','<input type="file" id="fileAudio" accept="audio/*" class="hide" />');
$('#fileAudio').addEventListener('change',async e=>{
  const f=e.target.files[0],sc=state.scenes[+e.target.dataset.i];e.target.value='';if(!f||!sc)return;
  try{
    const buf=await ensureAudio().decodeAudioData(await f.arrayBuffer());
    abuf[sc.id]=buf;if(sc.dur<buf.duration+0.9)sc.dur=+clamp(buf.duration+0.9,2,14).toFixed(1);
    renderScenes();refresh();
  }catch(e){setMsg('#msgScenes','Erro ao ler áudio.',true);}
});
function ensureAudio(){return new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();}

$('#btnPlay').addEventListener('click',()=>{playing?pause():play();});
$('#seek').addEventListener('input',e=>{const was=playing;if(was)pause();tPlay=clamp(e.target.value/1000)*totalDur();draw(tPlay);updateTime();if(was)play();});
$('#btnOne').addEventListener('click',oneClick);
$('#btnDownload').addEventListener('click',download);
$('#btnExportHTML').addEventListener('click',exportHTML);
$('#btnCancel').addEventListener('click',()=>{cancelFlag=true;});

(async function init(){
  if(!load()||!state.scenes.length)state.scenes=buildScenes(state.type);
  syncFields();renderScenes();setFormat();
  if(state.logo){const im=new Image();im.onload=()=>{logoImg=im;redraw();};im.src=state.logo;}
  redraw();
  await loadFonts();redraw();
  try{if(window.claude&&window.claude.use){sampleFn=await window.claude.use('sample');if(sampleFn){$('#btnAI').classList.remove('hide');$('#useAIwrap').classList.remove('hide');}}}catch(e){}
})();
})();
